methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Ark Electronics operates in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of 9 peers: 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private firms. Top private comparables include Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the peer set presents material constraints for valuation.

The peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage alignment. Of the 10 same-sector peers identified, none satisfy simultaneous filters for stage, timing, and valuation tier. The analysis required a minimum of 3 datapoints within narrow peer bands to establish credible median benchmarks; this threshold was not met. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce excessive heterogeneity and obscure stage-specific dynamics that typically drive private company valuations.

Given the data constraints, no triangulated valuation range can be supported with confidence. The primary limitation is the lack of stage-specific, same-sector comparable data. Any range derived from the broader peer set would conflate early-stage and growth-stage companies with potentially divergent multiples and growth profiles. To advance valuation, additional information is required: Ark's revenue, EBITDA, growth rate, capital efficiency metrics, and explicit stage positioning relative to the identified private peers. Without these data, quantitative triangulation remains incomplete.
